verdicts.reason: A drops the whole quote group into the lower half, leaving about 370px of dead space above and only about 100px below, with an oversized gap between the quote mark and the text, so it looks lopsided. B keeps the original's 3-line quote, sits balanced on a consistent left margin and stays faithful; its only real flaw is that the attribution is tiny at this size.

A centres the group vertically and sets the quote as two balanced lines with a clearly legible attribution, but the 44px left margin is tight and does not match the wider right margin. B is a faithful, well-placed scaled copy whose attribution is small and weak at this size, so A reads slightly better.

A shrinks the quote text while the quote mark and the bold, widely spaced attribution stay large, so the attribution nearly competes with the message. The group also sits high, with heavy empty space below. B keeps the quote clearly dominant and the layout balanced, apart from a small attribution.
